description: This file contains unit tests for the ExecApprovalHelpers module, including functions for parsing decisions, pattern matching, validation, and ask requirement logic within the OpenClaw project.

classes.name: ExecApprovalHelpersTests
classes.description: A container for multiple test functions verifying the behavior of ExecApprovalHelpers methods.

methods.name: parse decision trims and rejects invalid
methods.description: Tests the parsing of decision strings, ensuring trimming and invalid input handling works.

methods.name: allowlist pattern prefers resolution
methods.description: Verifies that allowlist pattern matching prefers the resolved path when available.

methods.name: validate allowlist pattern returns reasons
methods.description: Checks validation rules and reason returns for allowlist patterns.

methods.name: requires ask matches policy
methods.description: Tests whether ask-for-permission requirements align with policies and allowlist entries.
